256: void Codec::decodeHeader(const uint8_t *data, size_t size) {
257:   setParams(IVD_DECODE_HEADER);
258: 
259:   size_t numDecodeCalls = 0;
260: 
261:   while (size > 0 && numDecodeCalls < kMaxNumDecodeCalls) {
262:     IV_API_CALL_STATUS_T ret;
263:     ivd_video_decode_ip_t dec_ip{};
264:     ivd_video_decode_op_t dec_op{};
265:     size_t bytes_consumed;
266: 
267:     memset(&dec_ip, 0, sizeof(dec_ip));
268:     memset(&dec_op, 0, sizeof(dec_op));
269: 
270:     dec_ip.e_cmd = IVD_CMD_VIDEO_DECODE;
271:     dec_ip.u4_ts = 0;
272:     dec_ip.pv_stream_buffer = (void *)data;
273:     dec_ip.u4_num_Bytes = size;
274:     dec_ip.u4_size = sizeof(ivd_video_decode_ip_t);
275:     dec_op.u4_size = sizeof(ivd_video_decode_op_t);
276: 
277:     ret = ivd_api_function(mCodec, (void *)&dec_ip, (void *)&dec_op);
278: 
279:     bytes_consumed = dec_op.u4_num_bytes_consumed;
280:     /* If no bytes are consumed, then consume 4 bytes to ensure fuzzer proceeds
281:      * to feed next data */
282:     if (!bytes_consumed) bytes_consumed = 4;
283: 
284:     bytes_consumed = std::min(size, bytes_consumed);
285: 
286:     data += bytes_consumed;
287:     size -= bytes_consumed;
288:     numDecodeCalls++;
289: 
290:     mWidth = std::min(dec_op.u4_pic_wd, (UWORD32)10240);
291:     mHeight = std::min(dec_op.u4_pic_ht, (UWORD32)10240);
292: 
293:     /* Break after successful header decode */
294:     if (mWidth && mHeight) {
295:       break;
296:     }
297:   }
298:   /* if width / height are invalid, set them to defaults */
299:   if (!mWidth) mWidth = 1920;
300:   if (!mHeight) mHeight = 1088;
301: }

303: IV_API_CALL_STATUS_T Codec::decodeFrame(const uint8_t *data, size_t size,
304:                                         size_t *bytesConsumed) {
305:   IV_API_CALL_STATUS_T ret;
306:   ivd_video_decode_ip_t dec_ip{};
307:   ivd_video_decode_op_t dec_op{};
308: 
309:   memset(&dec_ip, 0, sizeof(dec_ip));
310:   memset(&dec_op, 0, sizeof(dec_op));
311: 
312:   dec_ip.e_cmd = IVD_CMD_VIDEO_DECODE;
313:   dec_ip.u4_ts = 0;
314:   dec_ip.pv_stream_buffer = (void *)data;
315:   dec_ip.u4_num_Bytes = size;
316:   dec_ip.u4_size = sizeof(ivd_video_decode_ip_t);
317:   dec_ip.s_out_buffer = mOutBufHandle;
318: 
319:   dec_op.u4_size = sizeof(ivd_video_decode_op_t);
320: 
321:   ret = ivd_api_function(mCodec, (void *)&dec_ip, (void *)&dec_op);
322: 
323:   /* In case of change in resolution, reset codec and feed the same data again
324:    */
325:   if (IVD_RES_CHANGED == (dec_op.u4_error_code & 0xFF)) {
326:     resetCodec();
327:     ret = ivd_api_function(mCodec, (void *)&dec_ip, (void *)&dec_op);
328:   }
329:   *bytesConsumed = dec_op.u4_num_bytes_consumed;
330: 
331:   /* If no bytes are consumed, then consume 4 bytes to ensure fuzzer proceeds
332:    * to feed next data */
333:   if (!*bytesConsumed) *bytesConsumed = 4;
334: 
335:   if (dec_op.u4_pic_wd && dec_op.u4_pic_ht &&
336:       (mWidth != dec_op.u4_pic_wd || mHeight != dec_op.u4_pic_ht)) {
337:     mWidth = std::min(dec_op.u4_pic_wd, (UWORD32)10240);
338:     mHeight = std::min(dec_op.u4_pic_ht, (UWORD32)10240);
339:     allocFrame();
340:   }
341: 
342:   return ret;
343: }

350: 
351:   size_t numDecodeCalls = 0;
352:   Codec *codec = new Codec(fdp);
353:   codec->createCodec(fdp);

355:   codec->setCores(fdp);

470: *  Function to initialize ps_pic_buf structs add pic buffers to
471: *  buffer manager in case of non-shared mode
472: *  To be called once per stream or for every reset
473: *
474: * @param[in] ps_codec
475: *  Pointer to codec context
476: *
477: * @returns  Error from IHEVCD_ERROR_T
478: *
479: * @remarks
480: *
481: *
482: *******************************************************************************
483: */
484: IHEVCD_ERROR_T ihevcd_pic_buf_mgr_add_bufs(codec_t *ps_codec)
485: {
486:     IHEVCD_ERROR_T ret = (IHEVCD_ERROR_T)IHEVCD_SUCCESS;
487:     WORD32 i;
488:     WORD32 max_dpb_size;
489:     sps_t *ps_sps;
490:     UWORD8 *pu1_buf;
491:     pic_buf_t *ps_pic_buf;
492:     WORD32 pic_buf_size_allocated;
493:     WORD32 h_samp_factor, v_samp_factor;
494: 
495: 
496: 
497: 
498:     /* Initialize Pic buffer manager */
499:     ps_sps = ps_codec->s_parse.ps_sps;
500: 
501:     h_samp_factor = (CHROMA_FMT_IDC_YUV420 == ps_sps->i1_chroma_format_idc) ? 2 : 1;
502:     v_samp_factor = (CHROMA_FMT_IDC_YUV444 == ps_sps->i1_chroma_format_idc) ? 1 : 2;
503: 
504:     /* Compute the number of Pic buffers needed */
505:     max_dpb_size = ps_sps->ai1_sps_max_dec_pic_buffering[ps_sps->i1_sps_max_sub_layers - 1];
506: 
507:     if(ps_codec->e_frm_out_mode != IVD_DECODE_FRAME_OUT)
508:         max_dpb_size += ps_sps->ai1_sps_max_num_reorder_pics[ps_sps->i1_sps_max_sub_layers - 1];
509: 
510:     /* Allocate one extra picture to handle current frame
511:      * In case of asynchronous parsing and processing, number of buffers should increase here
512:      * based on when parsing and processing threads are synchronized
513:      */
514:     max_dpb_size++;
515: 
516: 
517:     pu1_buf = (UWORD8 *)ps_codec->pu1_ref_pic_buf_base;
518: 
519:     ps_pic_buf = (pic_buf_t *)ps_codec->ps_pic_buf;
520: 
521:     /* In case of non-shared mode, add picture buffers to buffer manager
522:      * In case of shared mode buffers are added in the run-time
523:      */
524:     if(0 == ps_codec->i4_share_disp_buf)
525:     {
526:         WORD32 buf_ret;
527:         WORD32 luma_samples;
528:         WORD32 chroma_samples;
529:         pic_buf_size_allocated = ps_codec->i4_total_pic_buf_size;
530: 
531:         luma_samples = (ps_codec->i4_strd) *
532:                         (ps_sps->i2_pic_height_in_luma_samples + PAD_HT);
533: 
534:         if(CHROMA_FMT_IDC_MONOCHROME == ps_sps->i1_chroma_format_idc)
535:         {
536:             chroma_samples = 0;
537:         }
538:         else
539:         {
540:             chroma_samples = luma_samples * 2 / (h_samp_factor * v_samp_factor);
541:         }
542: 
543:         /* Try to add as many buffers as possible since memory is already allocated */
544:         /* If the number of buffers that can be added is less than max_num_bufs
545:          * return with an error.
546:          */
547:         for(i = 0; i < max_dpb_size; i++)
548:         {
549:             pic_buf_size_allocated -= (luma_samples + chroma_samples);
550: 
551:             if(pic_buf_size_allocated < 0)
552:             {
553:                 ps_codec->s_parse.i4_error_code = IHEVCD_INSUFFICIENT_MEM_PICBUF;
554:                 return IHEVCD_INSUFFICIENT_MEM_PICBUF;
555:             }
556: 
557:             ps_pic_buf->pu1_luma = pu1_buf + ps_codec->i4_strd * PAD_TOP + PAD_LEFT;
558:             pu1_buf += luma_samples;
559: 
560:             if(chroma_samples)
561:             {
562:                 ps_pic_buf->pu1_chroma = pu1_buf + ps_codec->i4_strd * (PAD_TOP / 2) + PAD_LEFT;
563:                 pu1_buf += chroma_samples;
564:             }
565:             else
566:             {
567:                 ps_pic_buf->pu1_chroma = NULL;
568:             }
569: 
570:             /* Pad boundary pixels (one pixel on all sides) */
571:             /* This ensures SAO does not read uninitialized pixels */
572:             /* Note these are not used in actual processing */
573:             {
574:                 UWORD8 *pu1_buf;
575:                 WORD32 strd, wd, ht;
576:                 WORD32 i;
577:                 strd = ps_codec->i4_strd;
578:                 wd = ps_codec->i4_wd;
579:                 ht = ps_codec->i4_ht;
580: 
581:                 pu1_buf = ps_pic_buf->pu1_luma;
582:                 for(i = 0; i < ht; i++)
583:                 {
584:                     pu1_buf[-1] = 0;
585:                     pu1_buf[wd] = 0;
586:                     pu1_buf += strd;
587:                 }
588:                 pu1_buf = ps_pic_buf->pu1_luma;
589:                 memset(pu1_buf - strd - 1, 0, wd + 2);
590: 
591:                 pu1_buf += strd * ht;
592:                 memset(pu1_buf - 1, 0, wd + 2);
593: 
594:                 if (ps_pic_buf->pu1_chroma)
595:                 {
596:                     pu1_buf = ps_pic_buf->pu1_chroma;
597:                     ht >>= 1;
598:                     for(i = 0; i < ht; i++)
599:                     {
600:                         pu1_buf[-1] = 0;
601:                         pu1_buf[-2] = 0;
602:                         pu1_buf[wd] = 0;
603:                         pu1_buf[wd + 1] = 0;
604:                         pu1_buf += strd;
605:                     }
606:                     pu1_buf = ps_pic_buf->pu1_chroma;
607:                     memset(pu1_buf - strd - 2, 0, wd + 4);
608: 
609:                     pu1_buf += strd * ht;
610:                     memset(pu1_buf - 2, 0, wd + 4);
611:                 }
612:             }
613: 
614:             buf_ret = ihevc_buf_mgr_add((buf_mgr_t *)ps_codec->pv_pic_buf_mgr, ps_pic_buf, i);
615: 
616: 
617:             if(0 != buf_ret)
618:             {
619:                 ps_codec->s_parse.i4_error_code = IHEVCD_BUF_MGR_ERROR;
620:                 return IHEVCD_BUF_MGR_ERROR;
621:             }
622:             ps_pic_buf++;
623:         }
624:     }
625:     else
626:     {
627:         /* In case of shared mode, buffers are added without adjusting for padding.
628:            Update luma and chroma pointers here to account for padding as per stride.
629:            In some cases stride might not be available when set_display_frame is called.
630:            Hence updated luma and chroma pointers here */
631: 
632:         for(i = 0; i < BUF_MGR_MAX_CNT; i++)
633:         {

#!/bin/bash
# One-shot MSan build of libhevc fuzzer + test tools.
# Runs inside the build environment where the OS is ephemeral but the
# workspace (and everything under /gt/_work) persists between calls.
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# 1. Install the clang-18 sanitizer runtimes (MSan + libFuzzer) in this session.
apt-get update > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y libclang-rt-18-dev > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "[build] runtime install done"

SRC=/gt/_work/src
BUILD=$SRC/build_msan
rm -rf "$BUILD"
mkdir -p "$BUILD"
cd "$BUILD"

# 2. Configure with MemorySanitizer.
cmake "$SRC" \
  -DSANITIZE=memory \
  -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo > cmake.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 cmake.log; exit 1; }
echo "[build] cmake configure ok"

# 3. Build targets (parallel).
nproc_val=$(nproc)
make -j"$nproc_val" hevc_dec_fuzzer hevcenc hevcdec > make.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 make.log; exit 1; }
echo "[build] make ok"
ls -la hevc_dec_fuzzer hevcenc hevcdec

# Generate a small YUV420 test clip and encode it to HEVC using hevcenc.
set -e
SRC=/gt/_work/src
cd "$SRC/build_msan"

W=${1:-64}
H=${2:-64}
FRAMES=${3:-5}
NAME=clip_${W}x${H}

python3 - "$W" "$H" "$FRAMES" "$NAME.yuv" <<'PY'
import sys
w, h, frames, out = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
# YUV420: Y = w*h, U = V = w*h/4
import random
random.seed(1234)
y_plane = bytearray()
u_plane = bytearray()
v_plane = bytearray()
with open(out, "wb") as f:
    for fr in range(frames):
        # deterministic gradient + noise pattern, varies per frame
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                val = (x * 2 + y * 3 + fr * 10) & 0xFF
                f.write(bytes([val]))
        for y in range(h // 2):
            for x in range(w // 2):
                f.write(bytes([(x * 4 + fr * 20) & 0xFF]))
        for y in range(h // 2):
            for x in range(w // 2):
                f.write(bytes([(y * 4 + fr * 30) & 0xFF]))
print("wrote", out)
PY

#!/bin/bash
# Run the MSan fuzzer on a candidate stream.
# Usage: run_fuzzer.sh <bitstream.265> [cores] [colorfmt_byte] [arch_byte] [yuvfmt_byte]
# Prepend 4 config bytes consumed by FuzzedDataProvider:
#   b0 % 7  -> color format index
#   b1 % 4  -> enable_yuv_formats index
#   b2 % 7  -> arch index
#   b3 % 4 + 1 -> num cores
set -e
SRC=/gt/_work/src
BS=${1:?bitstream}
CORES=${2:-3}
B0=${3:-0}
B1=${4:-0}
B2=${5:-4}
B3=$((CORES - 1))

cd "$SRC/build_msan"
printf "\\x$(printf %02x $B0)\\x$(printf %02x $B1)\\x$(printf %02x $B2)\\x$(printf %02x $B3)" > /tmp/poc.bin
cat "$BS" >> /tmp/poc.bin

echo "=== input: $BS cores=$CORES b0=$B0 b1=$B1 b2=$B2 b3=$B3 (size $(stat -c%s /tmp/poc.bin))"
MSAN_OPTIONS="exit_code=86:halt_on_error=1:report_umrs=1" ./hevc_dec_fuzzer /tmp/poc.bin 2>&1 | tail -40
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo "=== fuzzer rc=$RC"
exit 0

declare -a CLIPS=(clip_63x64.265 clip_64x63.265 clip_63x63.265 clip_66x66.265 clip_96x96.265 clip_32x32.265 clip_33x34.265 clip_80x80.265)
declare -a CORES=(2 3 4)

declare -a B1S=(0 1 2 3)
declare -a B2S=(4 5 6)

CRASH=0
for CLIP in "${CLIPS[@]}"; do
  SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$CLIP")
  for CORES in "${CORES[@]}"; do
    B3=$((CORES - 1))
    for B0 in "${B0S[@]}"; do
      for B1 in "${B1S[@]}"; do
        for B2 in "${B2S[@]}"; do
          printf "\\x$(printf %02x $B0)\\x$(printf %02x $B1)\\x$(printf %02x $B2)\\x$(printf %02x $B3)" > /tmp/poc.bin
          # full
          cat "$CLIP" >> /tmp/poc.bin
          OUT=$(MSAN_OPTIONS="exit_code=86:halt_on_error=1" ./hevc_dec_fuzzer /tmp/poc.bin 2>&1)
          RC=$?
          if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== CRASH FULL $CLIP cores=$CORES b0=$B0 b1=$B1 b2=$B2 rc=$RC"
            echo "$OUT" | grep -E "WARNING: MemorySanitizer|SUMMARY:|ihevcd" | head -8
            CRASH=1
          fi
          # truncated at 60%
          N=$((SIZE * 60 / 100))
          head -c $N "$CLIP" > /tmp/trunc.265
          printf "\\x$(printf %02x $B0)\\x$(printf %02x $B1)\\x$(printf %02x $B2)\\x$(printf %02x $B3)" > /tmp/poc.bin
          cat /tmp/trunc.265 >> /tmp/poc.bin
          OUT=$(MSAN_OPTIONS="exit_code=86:halt_on_error=1" ./hevc_dec_fuzzer /tmp/poc.bin 2>&1)

            CRASH=1
          fi
          if [ $CRASH -eq 1 ]; then exit 0; fi
        done
      done
    done
  done
done
echo "no crash found"

import os, glob, itertools
outdir = "/gt/_work/fuzz_out.corpus"
